note: Quantities the manuscript cites that are derived from the pipeline but appear inside no results/ file. Regenerate with `make facts`. atlas.check_manuscript_numbers compares the manuscript's stated guardrail count against guardrail_tests_passing_from_archive rather than looking it up in the value pool: both 102 and 118 -- the counts this manuscript carried before -- match exactly one unrelated pipeline value each, so a stale count would be reported as verified. How many tests PASS depends on the checkout (a release archive ships data/ and results/, a git archive does not), so the passing count must be measured from the release at release time. It also depends on whether the machine running them can reach the network: one test verifies mapped reference bases against the Ensembl REST API and skips without it, so the archive figure is the offline one -- what a reader without network access reproduces -- and archive_measured_for_version records the reachable figure alongside it so neither can be quoted without the other.
archive_measured_for_version: the v2.5.0 release archive, measured on 2026-09-14 from a clean extract with HOME pointed at an empty directory: 178 passed, 24 skipped, 202 collected. Twenty-three of those skips are the same on any machine -- they need something a reader does not have (a git checkout, the author's submission directory, or the hygiene denylist, which is deliberately not archived). The twenty-fourth is tests/test_mapping.py, which checks mapped reference bases against the Ensembl REST API and skips when that service is unreachable. It skipped in every run of this release: with the API deliberately unreachable, and with the network available, where Ensembl REST answered each attempt that day with a server error (503, then 500). The reachable figure, 179 passed and 23 skipped, was last observed on the v2.4.4 archive; v2.5.0 adds no test, so the collected count and both figures are unchanged. v2.5.0 adds atlas.lr_basis_check, its three results files, docs/lr-basis-check.md and Supplementary Note S15
bare_clone_measured_for: a fresh clone of main, independent virtualenv on Python 3.12.13, HOME pointed at an empty directory: 130 passed, 72 skipped; results/, data/ and the package absent. Measured on 2026-09-09 at a662470, the first commit past the v2.4.3 deposit.
